verdict.rationale: Isaac is a robotics platform with an on-robot deployment arm (Isaac ROS on Jetson), so on-robot data capture and cloud sync is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence, however, documents no on-robot telemetry logging, no cloud sync, and no bandwidth-aware upload policies. The closest items are simulated stereo capture in Isaac Sim and teleoperation demonstration capture for GR00T post-training, which are adjacent data-collection features rather than this pipeline.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture sensor and telemetry data on-robot and sync it to the cloud with bandwidth-aware policies
